correctness.rationale: For each pair independently, assigning each positive-weight job to the endpoint with smaller accumulated pair-restricted load gives a last-assigned-job deletion witness after every arrival. Unit-size strong EF1 iff |2x_ij-q_ij|<=1, equivalent to strong EFX, and the odd-multiplicity leftover orientations have base loads b_i. Capacitated Hall on induced subsets gives exactly the ceiling of max_S (sum b_i+|E(H[S])|)/|S|. Direct independent orientation enumeration checked all 27 three-agent and 729 four-agent low-multiplicity profiles, and the two-job-per-spoke star gives fair n-1 vs unrestricted 2.
residual_risks: Fairness notion is both-sided pair-restricted strong EF1, not ordinary EF1; weights must be common across eligible agents for each job and unit size for the max-load formula.
